legal.privacyMetaDescription: How MYPOS collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
legal.privacyBody:
This Privacy Policy explains how MYPOS ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects personal data submitted through this website, in accordance with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

What we collect
When you use our contact form, we collect the information you provide: name, phone number, email address (if given), the product you're interested in, and your message.

Why we collect it
We use this information solely to respond to your inquiry, provide quotes, and follow up on sales and support requests. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

How long we keep it
We retain contact form submissions for as long as needed to handle your inquiry and any resulting business relationship, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

Your rights
Under the PDPA, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details on our Contact page.

Cookies
This site uses a minimal set of cookies necessary for the site to function (e.g. remembering your cookie consent choice, and your selected language). We do not currently use tracking or advertising cookies.

Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.
